description_for_human: Giuseppe's factory floor: the menu, the pantry, and real pizza orders.
description_for_model: Giuseppe's tools for the live Copilot Pizza Factory. Use them to browse the menu (list_pizzas), look up a pizza's toppings and timings (get_recipe), read ingredient stock (get_stock) or check whether a pizza can be made right now (check_can_make), place real orders on the factory floor (create_order), and track them (get_order_status, list_orders). Every menu item, stock level and order confirmation must come from these tools - never invent them.

functions.name: list_pizzas
functions.description: List the pizzas on the menu.

functions.name: get_recipe
functions.description: Get a pizza's toppings and prep/bake times.

functions.name: get_stock
functions.description: List the current grams in stock for every ingredient.

functions.name: check_can_make
functions.description: Check whether there is enough stock to make a given pizza right now.

functions.name: create_order
functions.description: Place a new order for a pizza from the menu. Returns the created order with its id and state. Orders above 24 of one pizza are refused - split large events into multiple orders with a real headcount.

pizza.description: Pizza name from the menu, e.g. 'Hawaii' or 'Diavolo'.

amount.description: How many of this pizza to make (1 to 24).

customerName.description: Optional display name to show on the factory floor.

functions.name: get_order_status
functions.description: Get the current status of a single order by its id.

orderId.description: The order id returned by create_order.

functions.name: list_orders
functions.description: List orders, optionally filtered by state (created, started, ready, delivered).

state.description: Optional state filter. Omit to list all orders.
